purpose: Append-only live coordination ledger for Lane A and Lane B training work.

before_every_new_task: Fresh-read the latest peer blotter event(s).
Fresh-read the exact source branch/head the task will use.
Check declared peer resource claims and intended write paths for overlap.
Publish an INTENT event containing the observed peer event, lease SHA, source head, scope, resource claims, and write paths before material execution.
during_task: Publish a CHECKPOINT after every material state transition: source write/commit, process launch/kill, GPU or cloud resource change, test/eval completion or failure, artifact/receipt creation, or newly discovered HOLD condition.
Before starting a second task, repeat the full pre-task read/verify sequence even if the first task is still running.
Do not silently reuse stale peer state from conversation memory.
after_task: Publish RESULT, HOLD, or CANCEL with exact subject head, artifacts/hashes where available, tests/evidence, effects performed, and remaining next action.
Peer must fresh-read the terminal event before beginning any task that depends on its result.
peer_ack_required_before_execution: GPU launch or GPU process stop/start affecting shared runtime.
Paid Hugging Face or other paid compute.
Edits to overlapping files or the same source branch/worktree.
Merge, deploy, activate, provider/runtime configuration, credential changes, or destructive cleanup.
Any task whose declared resource claim conflicts with an active peer task.
peer_ack_not_required_but_preflight_stil: New isolated branch/worktree edits with disjoint write paths.
Unit-test or corpus-analysis tasks that do not consume protected evaluation material.
rules.conflict_rule: On conflict, ambiguity, stale source, stale lease, or missing required ACK, publish HOLD and do not execute the conflicting effect.
rules.append_only_rule: Never rewrite another lane's historical event. Corrections are new CORRECTION events referencing the superseded event_id.
rules.no_background_claim_rule: A lane may only claim RUNNING when an actual process/task has been launched and can be read back. Conversation intent is not execution evidence.

claim_boundary: This blotter coordinates work. It does not authorize paid compute, merges, deployment, activation, protected evaluation consumption, or destructive effects.
